lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: What kind of stuff did he wanna do ta Jodi that she wouldn't let him?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: .......... So tell me again why he told you that he was going ta do this to Teresa. The whole story.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Cuz he was pissed off about Jodi being in jail because the first time it was her old boyfriend and then, that ah she had ta go ta jail again for drunkin' driving cuz Steven thought that she had a drinking problem.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: OK. What else did he say?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: That he was trying to help her ta stop drinking and ta help her try ta get her daughter back.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: OK. Good. Did he blame Teresa for Jodi being in jail?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Then why did he pick Teresa?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: At what point did you put her cell phone and camera and purse and stuff in the burn barrel?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Well not probably, who did? If ya know you can tell me. You went over there.
